examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Five quote cards at the width the home page uses, wider together than the row, so the track scrolls and both controls are live. The cards meet with no gutter and the row fades at the end that continues. Drag the track, swipe it, or focus it and use the arrow keys: the step controls are one way in, not the only one. Each control disables itself at its end of the track, so a reader is never offered a step that does nothing.

examples.name: Peek
examples.summary: Narrower cards, so one lands part-way across the trailing edge under the fade. That partial card is the whole point: it tells a reader the track continues before they have touched a control. Narrow the viewport and the peek stays. The card width is fixed, so the row simply shows fewer of them.
